name: 星图观测站

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. A small futuristic neighborhood observatory: graphite low rectangular annex, compact rounded telescope dome on roof, modest satellite receiver dish, cyan panel accents, amber doorway. No giant tower. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately
